title: EvaluationContext
description: Runtime aggregate produced before LOOP(STEP 3, STEP 4). Materialized once per evaluation run; immutable thereafter. Persisted at ./runs/<eval_id>/evaluation_context.json. Never written back into contract files.

evaluation_id.description: Stable identifier for this evaluation run (UUID or timestamped slug).

role.description: STEP 0 output. Object form is authoritative. A bare string is accepted only as legacy input and is normalized by STEP 0 into the object form (role_id = string, empty industry/responsibility_tags, caveat appended).

oneOf.description: DEPRECATED legacy bare-string role. STEP 0 wraps it into the object form before any downstream step reads it.

industry.description: Convenience mirror of employee.role.industry; populated by STEP 0 for STEP 1.2 input.

job_responsibilities.description: Free-text day-to-day responsibilities. Primary semantic signal for STEP 1.2 curation.

employee_provenance.description: STEP 0 resolution provenance (K17). Surfaced byte-identically in EvaluationReport.employee_provenance.

caveat.description: Required (non-empty) when reliability == 'low'. Canonical values: 'employee_inferred_no_authoritative_source', 'role_id_no_catalog_entry' (may be combined).

candidate_metrics.description: STEP 1 deterministic role-filter output (the role-filtered subset of metric_registry). STEP 1.2 transforms this into selected_metrics. Optional at schema level for backward-compat: legacy contexts carry only selected_metrics, which STEP 2 treats as candidate_metrics (R16.4).

dropped_metrics.description: STEP 1 audit trail: metrics in metric_registry not in candidate_metrics, each with drop_reason. Required for K9 auditability.

selected_metrics.description: STEP 1.2 curateMetrics output: selected_metrics = (candidate_metrics − removed) ∪ added. When STEP 1.2 mode is 'never' / skipped / fails, equals candidate_metrics. Consumed by STEP 2 / STEP 4. Each entry is a snapshot reference, not the full metric body.

curate_log.description: STEP 1.2 audit trail (K18). One entry per removed/added decision. len(curate_log) == len(removed) + len(added).

evidence.description: At least one citation (K18). Each names a source field and quotes a verbatim substring of that field's value.

confirmed_by_user.description: true = human confirmed; false = human declined / timed out; 'auto_applied' = confidence >= auto_apply_threshold, applied without asking.

policy_violation.description: Set when this entry records a max_metrics / min_dimensions_covered block (R12.8/12.9).

metric_selection_policy.description: Governs STEP 1.2 invocation and bounds. All optional fields apply their declared defaults when omitted.

employee_resolution_log.description: STEP 0 audit trail. One entry per user-confirmation round (R2.8): displayed draft, user response type, corrections, final confirmed draft.

user_consultation_log.description: Shared K11 user-consultation log. Holds both STEP 1.5 scenario consultations and STEP 1.2 low-confidence-add confirmations.

enriched_test_cases.description: References to enriched test cases (id only) to keep the context compact. Full bodies live in their own files.

fan_out_plan.description: Cartesian product of (test_case_id, metric_code) that STEP 4 must execute.

drivers_dir.description: Directory containing one subdirectory per runtime driver. Default './runtime-drivers/'. Overridable via EVALUATION_DRIVERS_DIR.

simulators_dir.description: Directory containing one subdirectory per user simulator. Default './simulators/'. Overridable via EVALUATION_SIMULATORS_DIR.

runtime_driver.description: Selects which runtime driver under paths.drivers_dir/<driver_id>/ STEP 3 invokes, and supplies the protocol-specific configuration that the driver's manifest config_schema validates. STEP 3 MUST validate driver_config against the chosen driver's driver.json#/config_schema BEFORE invoking the entry.

driver_id.description: MUST equal an existing subdirectory name under paths.drivers_dir. STEP 3 fails fast if not found.

driver_config.description: Protocol-specific configuration. Validated against the selected driver's driver.json#/config_schema, NOT here.

runtime_simulator.description: Selects which simulator role profile under paths.simulators_dir/<simulator_id>/ the host evaluation-expert agent loads when impersonating the customer in STEP 3. The simulator is NOT a subprocess and does NOT call any external LLM — the host agent's own LLM brain consumes the simulator's system_prompt template. There is no `simulator_config` field by design: model / temperature / api_key choices belong to the host agent's runtime, not to this contract.

simulator_id.description: MUST equal an existing subdirectory name under paths.simulators_dir. STEP 3 fails fast if not found.

prompt_overrides.description: Optional per-run overrides for prompt-template variables (e.g. tighten {{effective_max_turns}} or inject extra context). Treated as advisory hints by the host agent; never used to swap in a different LLM provider.

global_turn_cap.description: Fallback hard upper bound on customer-employee exchanges per scenario, used when a test case does not specify turn_budget.hard_max_turns. STEP 3 chooses the smaller of (test_case.turn_budget.hard_max_turns, global_turn_cap) to enforce.
